scope: Whole-GPU samples clipped to target GPU intervals; mixed-process traffic

3.name: Kernel Occupancy
3.description: Percentage of shader core resources that are occupied by the compute kernel

17.name: Integer and Conditional Limiter
17.description: Measures the time during which Integer and Conditional work is executed as a percentage of peak Integer and Conditional performance. A value of 100% indicates Integer and Conditional execution pipeline has reached full capacity and cannot process more Integer and Conditional instructions in parallel

21.name: Integer and Complex Limiter
21.description: Measures the time during which Integer and Complex work is attemped to execute as a percentage of peak Integer and Complex performance. A value of 100% indicates Integer and Complex execution pipeline has reached full capacity and cannot process more Integer and Complex instructions in parallel

23.name: L1 Cache Limiter
23.description: Measures the time during which shader core L1 cache is attempting to service read and write requests as a percentage of cache’s peak performance

24.name: L1 Cache Utilization
24.description: Measures the time during which GPU’s L1 cache serviced read and write requests as a percentage of cache’s peak performance

46.name: Buffer L1 Miss Rate
46.description: Percentage buffer L1 cache accesses are misses from shader

68.name: Buffer L1 Read Bandwidth
68.description: L1 read bandwidth that is used by buffers in GiB/s

69.name: Buffer L1 Write Bandwidth
69.description: L1 write bandwidth that is used by buffers in GiB/s

70.name: GPU Bandwidth
70.description: Measures how much memory, in gigabytes per second, are read or written by the GPU to a memory external to the GPU (potentially device memory).

71.name: GPU Read Bandwidth
71.description: Measures how much memory, in gigabytes per second, are read by the GPU from a memory external to the GPU (potentially device memory)

72.name: GPU Write Bandwidth
72.description: Measures how much memory, in gigabytes per second, are written by the GPU to a memory external to the GPU (potentially device memory).

79.name: MMU Limiter
79.description: Measures the time during which GPU is attempting to execute read and write requests through MMU due to last level cache misses as a percentage of peak MMU performance

80.name: MMU Utilization
80.description: Measures the time during which GPU serviced read and write requests through MMU due to last level cache misses as a percentage of peak MMU performance

81.name: Last Level Cache Limiter
81.description: Measures the time during which GPU’s last level cache is attempting to service read and write requests as a percentage of cache’s peak performance

82.name: Last Level Cache Utilization
82.description: Measures the time during which GPU’s last level cache serviced read and write requests as a percentage of cache’s peak performance

83.name: Last Level Cache Bandwidth
83.description: Measures how much memory, in gigabytes per second, are read or written by the GPU's last level cache
